contract.description:
# Supplier 商品品牌选择、保存与回读

PHP 实际商品编辑抽屉用可逐级选择的品牌 Cascader 提交完整根到当前品牌路径。旧控件的 initBran 会递归把编号转成字符串；后端兼容规范的正整数十进制字符串与整数，归一后检查重复、父子链、最多16级和CSV最多64字符。新 TypeScript 控件发送数字路径，仍可选择根、子级或孙级。

显式 brand_id=[] 清空，省略则不修改主表 brand_id、brand_com 或 type=2 关系。主表保存末级编号及完整CSV，各级关系保持 status=1、relation_pid=0。只有平台、显示、未删除且父链完整的品牌可以新绑定。真实品牌行按编号锁定，目录变更争用返回409；保存继续下架并重置待审，不能借品牌编辑批准商品。

读取返回数字路径和原始编号、CSV、一致性及可选性。缺失、隐藏、格式错误或关联矛盾的历史品牌仍允许读取整个商品；界面显示原绑定并允许明确替换或清空。未修改品牌时，目录加载失败不妨碍保存其他字段。复制继续继承来源品牌，创建后再从普通编辑页调整。

新品牌写入只拥有两列与 type=2 关系。完整商品行、原有定时计划及其他隐藏关系在保存末端核对；跳过、改写和延后触发器异常均回滚。本次显式品牌操作在返回前执行 SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE，结算当前事务延后约束；不宣称对任意嵌套调用者的约束延后模式透明。旧请求省略品牌时不执行该语句。现有编辑GET由成熟多次查询组成，不宣称重复读快照。

目录刷新保留选择意图，路由切换、卸载和真实会话／权限变化会取消请求并永久失效当前控件；账号恢复后需重新进入。Axios排队请求也检查捕获的上下文。浏览器取消不撤销已经提交的服务端事务，普通保存没有复制专用的UUID恢复协议。

原品牌目录、完整复制、关联服务、定时执行器、权限配置和用户选定的已恢复 PHP 兼容 get_script 保持。仅本机合成库及生产构建验收，不涉及生产DDL、授权、部署或真实provider调用；完整商品抽屉和整体迁移仍未完成。实际命令、结果与失败历史见同名审计账本。

最终13个测试入口514项通过：445单元／组件、68真实App／JWT／独立PG16与1生产构建IAB。Worker两套类型、Supplier类型和生产构建通过。IAB实际37表／36序列，30次业务GET不写库，两次POST分别保存孙级路径与明确清空，原有非零上下架计划和隐藏字段／关系保持；目录变更仅自有Admin夹具隐藏父品牌102。真实账号21→22→21使表单与目录永久失效，扣留响应socket已取消，重新进入读取空品牌。桌面1280×720、移动390×844无横向溢出，控制台抽样0warning／error，截图实际JPEG1265×712、375×812。两座本机PG16独立核验停止、夹具清零。

初轮前端44项中43项通过，创建路由期望误写为/product/product/0，按成熟真实API修正测试。其后初版415项通过仍未覆盖PHP字符串合同；从真实initBran发现该细节后修正后端并增加实际App字符串／混合请求及规则、排队与权限用例，最终445+68重新执行。初轮与重复命令均不增加最终测试数。所有最终命令绑定同一17份执行源码指纹。258份成熟文件全字节不变；原88／404条复选行保持。

发布到独立codex/supplier-product-brand，草稿PR以codex/supplier-product-schedule为基线，仅展示本批品牌增量。已有main和PR102的CI仍保留，未取消、未自动合入；新提交云端状态需推送后按精确head另行观察。整体goal active、completion false。

GET_new_fields.brand_id: number[] from actual strict raw CSV, [] when malformed
GET_new_fields.brand_selection: exact4: brand_id(actual signed int4 scalar), brand_com(actual raw varchar64), consistent:boolean, available:boolean

wire_compatibility.POST: Optional brand_id complete root-to-node array <=16 entries / normalized CSV<=64chars. Elements accept positive number int4 or canonical /^[1-9]\d{0,9}$/ decimal strings bounded to int4; normalize to number[]. No whitespace, leading zero, sign, exponent, fraction, null or bool coercions. Duplicate detection runs after normalization. Explicit[] clears; omission does not update main two columns/type2 relations.
wire_compatibility.write_locks: Existing live Supplier actor/role authority and product fence; ordered NOWAIT row SHARE on actual store_brand ids, current store_id0/show1/del0 and each exact parent.
wire_compatibility.read_invalid: Missing, hidden, malformed or contradictory old brands are not selection authority and do not block the whole editor read; raw original metadata remains available to display and explicitly clear/replace.
wire_compatibility.preservation: Actual complete expected ordinary-save product row plus protected non-category/non-brand association rows; brand helper writes only brandId/brandCom and relation.type2. Mature isShow0/isVerify0 reset retained.
wire_compatibility.deferred_constraints: New explicit brand authoring executes SET CONSTRAINTS ALL IMMEDIATE before final actual row/relationship readback. This is a deliberate independent HTTP transaction success condition, not a claim of transparent arbitrary nested caller deferral mode. Omitted-brand legacy path never runs it.

contract.read_snapshot: Mature multi-query editor GET; no repeatable-read claim.
contract.browser_abort: Cancelling browser requests does not undo an already committed server transaction. Ordinary save has no copy UUID recovery protocol.

validation.accepted_inputs: All 17 execution fingerprints exact in each accepted terminal command. Documentation additions are not execution inputs.

history_notes: Initial frontend44:43 passed, one failed because new-create test expected /product/product/0 while real mature API uses /product/product. Corrected the test expectation.

Number-only backend rule corrected, four real string/mixed App cases and14 rule cases added; root added four queue/permission frontend cases. Final445+68 re-executed. Initial415 does not prove final compatibility or add final tests.
